standard.label: neuroSHARE Standard Intro
standard.content:
Welcome to the neuroSHARE Survey

This survey will take about 20–25 minutes to complete.

Expect assignments focused on:

  • Speech & Voice
  • Sleep
  • Smell
  • Colour vision
  • Hearing
  • Thinking skills
Please respond authentically and naturally.

standard.label: neuroSHARE Standard Instructions
standard.content:
Before you start

  • Find a quiet space: Sit at a table in a room without interruptions. Close any windows and turn off the TV.
  • Disconnect headphones: Use your device's built-in microphone and speakers.
  • Check your device battery and internet connection: Ensure stable internet and sufficiently charged battery.

standard.label: neuroSHARE Standard Consent
standard.content:
Consent to Participate in the neuroSHARE Study

The aim of the study is to better understand changes in brain function. To describe these changes, we examine your speech, color vision, sleep, hearing, and facial movements. The results of this study may help develop new tools for earlier detection of the risk of neurodegenerative diseases and for improving their care and treatment.

The study involves several simple tasks performed using your phone. The total duration is around 20-25 minutes. As a reward for completing the tests, we would like to offer you a reward of 400 CZK.

In the second part of the study, you will be invited to undergo verification of these tests under laboratory conditions. For visiting the CTU (Czech Technical University) laboratory in Prague, we would like to offer you a reward of 1300 CZK. The total reward for participation in the neuroSHARE Remote study is 1700 CZK.

This study is conducted by the SHARE-ERIC project in cooperation with the Economics Institute of the Czech Academy of Sciences (CERGE-EI), the First Faculty of Medicine of Charles University, the General University Hospital in Prague, and the Czech Technical University in Prague (ČVUT).

Participation in this study is voluntary, and your information is confidential. Full details on how we ensure the confidentiality of your data, as well as details about your rights, can be found in the Privacy Statement on the SHARE website (share.cerge-ei.cz).

The second part of the study involves verifying the phone results under laboratory conditions at ČVUT. To arrange a visit, we will need your phone number and email address.

Clicking Next I agree to participate in the study, to the processing of my personal data, and to providing my contact details for arranging a visit at ČVUT.
